_comment: SSE event-type baseline for the companies sync, captured at the Phase 1 refactor boundary. The Phase 1 engine refactor preserves every SSE emit call from pre-refactor verbatim — this fixture documents the expected event-type sequence so Phase 2+ regressions are caught early. Payload values may vary across runs (rate, eta, hsId, name); the *type sequence* must remain identical.
scenario: manual UI trigger, 7 HubSpot companies fetched, SYNC_CONCURRENCY=5, all dedup-resolved as creates, no errors

invariants.record_before_progress: Every `record` event for a batch fires before that batch's `progress` event. Within a batch the records emit in unordered Promise.all completion order.
invariants.progress_after_each_batch: Exactly one `progress` event after each batch of up to SYNC_CONCURRENCY companies.
invariants.done_terminates_stream: Exactly one `done` event at the end. The route handler closes the SSE response when it sees `done`.
invariants.skipped_short_circuit: If `checkConnectionsForSkip` returns a non-null reason, the engine emits a single `done` event with status='skipped' and writes a skipped history record. No `record` or `progress` events fire.

emit_sites_preserved: src/sync/engine.ts: emit({ type: 'record', status: 'skipped', ... }) — DRY_RUN branch
src/sync/engine.ts: emit({ type: 'record', status: 'updated', ... }) — existing-entity branch
src/sync/engine.ts: emit({ type: 'record', status: 'created', ... }) — new-entity branch
src/sync/engine.ts: emit({ type: 'record', status: 'error', ... }) — catch branch
src/sync/engine.ts: emit({ type: 'progress', ... }) — after each batch
src/sync/engine.ts: emit({ type: 'done', status, ... }) — end of run
src/sync/engine.ts: sseEmitter?.({ type: 'done', status: 'skipped', ... }) — short-circuit path
phase_2_plus_additions: Phase 4 may add deals-only event payloads (e.g. archived counter on `progress`) — the *type set* `record | progress | done` does not change.
